name.description: The component name. Required unless --document is given; defaults to the dasherized node id.

document.description: Workspace-relative path to a canonical OpenUI JSON document (*.openui.json or *.json). Compiles a SurfaceContainers node into the component and compiles and embeds its children.

nodeId.description: Optional element ID within the OpenUI document to compile. When omitted, targets the first SurfaceContainers element. Requires --document.
